mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO om_ai_data_evidence (task_id, data_type, data_id, evidence_id, evidence_role, creator_id, create_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{dataType}, #{dataId}, #{evidenceId}, #{evidenceRole}, #{creatorId}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT evidence.*, file.file_name, file.file_url, data_evidence.evidence_role FROM om_ai_data_evidence data_evidence INNER JOIN om_ai_evidence evidence ON evidence.id = data_evidence.evidence_id INNER JOIN om_ai_file file ON file.id = evidence.file_id WHERE data_evidence.data_type = #{dataType} AND data_evidence.data_id = #{dataId} ORDER BY evidence.file_id, evidence.block_no
